outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: (1) The agent’s location confirmation for the specific listing isn’t clearly shown on-page in the provided evidence; however, the URL parameters show the search context included Redmond, Washington, which many users would accept as adequate context for finding a relevant listing. This is minor compared to the missing required data.

Critical issues: (1) The agent did not provide two key responsibilities and did not provide two preferred qualifications. These are explicitly required outputs and are the main deliverable of the task. (2) The agent’s final response is essentially an informed failure: it claims the DOM did not expose the needed sections’ bullet content and therefore it cannot extract the required details. Regardless of whether the site/DOM capture was problematic, the user did not receive the requested information.

Outcome assessment: The agent successfully navigated Microsoft Careers, ran the search for “Applied Scientist” with location “Redmond, Washington,” and opened a relevant listing page. Screenshot evidence (DOM state index 4) supports that it correctly extracted the job number (200017828) and work-site arrangement (“Work site 3 days / week in-office,” reasonably paraphrased as hybrid 3 days/week in-office). However, it failed to extract and report the two responsibilities and two preferred qualifications, and it did not explicitly state those sections were unavailable on the page in a way that yields the required extracted content. Since those missing items are the core of what the user asked to “report,” the task is not successfully completed.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to use Microsoft Careers to find and open one Applied Scientist job listing in Redmond, WA, then extract and report four specific pieces of information from that listing: job number, work-site arrangement, two key responsibilities, and two preferred qualifications. A reasonable user would be flexible on which exact Applied Scientist listing is chosen (as long as it’s relevant and in/around the specified location), but would not be flexible on missing any of the required extracted fields—especially responsibilities and preferred qualifications, which are core deliverables.
